features: DOES NOT CHANGE THE DATABASE SCHEMA, BUT THE UPDATE TIDIES UP TWO FILES — No new migration and no data rewritten: instalments, balances, journal entries and documents stay as they were. A migration that already existed, the one that puts documents in more than one category, now removes the old category column, with its constraint, after moving its value into the links between documents and categories; it does so with two separate checks: a run interrupted halfway resumes from where it had got to, and where it has already run it does nothing. Outside the database two things change. (1) If the panel update engine of an earlier version added to the .env file the block «# --- AUTO-CONFIGURED BY V1.9 UPGRADER ---» with TRUSTED_PROXIES=*, after the update the application, where the update from the panel is enabled, replaces it with TRUSTED_PROXIES=PRIVATE_SUBNETS and a comment saying what changed, as it already did with the 1.9 block; a TRUSTED_PROXIES line written by hand, or a block changed by hand, stays as it is. (2) An update_bridge.json file left in the main folder of the installation is removed, at the end of the update or when the updates page is opened: the exchange file of the panel update now lives in storage/app. No new permission. The links in the password reset and email verification e-mails change: after the update check APP_URL in the .env file (in the Docker image, the APP_URL environment variable), as the first entry below says. The beta also reviews the panel update engine and the install command of the Docker image (the entries below); the 1.11.0 security advisories are published with the stable release, in the repository's security advisories. The two changes to check after the update (the e-mail links) come first. After the update, reload the pages you already have open.

CHANGES: THE LINKS IN THE PASSWORD RESET AND EMAIL VERIFICATION E-MAILS — The links in the «Password dimenticata?» (forgot password) e-mail and in the e-mail asking to verify the email address carry the address written in APP_URL in the .env file (in the Docker image, the APP_URL environment variable), with its subfolder if there is one. If APP_URL is still the shipped default (empty, without http:// or https:// in front, or with the host localhost, 127.0.0.1 or [::1]), they carry the address the request came from: set APP_URL. After the update check that APP_URL is the address you open the application with, with https:// if the application runs on https: with http:// on an application running on https, or with another name (with or without www, an extra subfolder), the links lead there, and if the application does not answer there they do not open. Email verification links sent before the update are no longer valid: opening one shows «Il link che stai utilizzando potrebbe essere scaduto o non più valido.» (the link you are using may have expired or is no longer valid), and on the «Verifica indirizzo email» (verify email address) page the «Reinvia email di verifica» (resend verification email) button sends a new one. Password reset links already sent stay valid until they expire.

CHANGES: THE INSTALMENT PLAN PAGE, «SPOSTA SPESA» AND THE TASK LINKS FOLLOW THE PLAN'S FINANCIAL YEAR — On a management linked to more than one financial year (that is how the importer creates it, and how the ordinary management used every year stays) the instalment plan page, the limit of «Sposta spesa» (move expense) and the links of the tasks that the generation creates (the surpluses of the amount already paid, the unassigned shares) read the plan's financial year. Before, they read the first financial year they found among those of the management, in no particular order: with «Spese generali» (general expenses) at € 1,200.00 in the plan, € 1,000.00 of invoices in 2026 and € 100.00 in 2027, depending on the order in which the financial years had been created «Sposta spesa» of € 500.00 on the 2027 plan was refused with the € 200.00 limit of 2026, or on the 2026 plan went through and left the item uncovered by € 300.00. Now the limit is € 200.00 on the 2026 plan and € 1,100.00 on the 2027 one; the plan page shows, per person and per unit, the balance of the plan's financial year; the task links open the plan inside its financial year. A plan created without «Genera calcolo scadenze subito» (generate the due-date calculation now) remembers the financial year of the page it was created from as soon as it is created. Instalments already generated do not change.

CHANGES: THE GENERATION GATE FOR A SUCCESSION COUNTS THE BALANCES OF EVERY FINANCIAL YEAR — When an instalment plan still counts the share of a deceased person, the generation gate compares the part that passes to the heirs with the balances that the plan actually absorbs: those of the management in every financial year, not only in the plan's financial year. On a management linked to more than one financial year, a plan for the earlier year generated when the later year is already open no longer asks to record from the Wallet a part that is already there (in the test, Ugo's part, € 394.52, passed to Anna for € 236.71 and to Bruno for € 157.81, recorded from the Wallet in 2027 for the 2026 plan). When the plan takes the previous balances and someone has their part in a financial year that the Wallet does not show, the item says so: «I saldi dell'esercizio «Esercizio 2026» non compaiono nel Wallet, che mostra un solo esercizio aperto: il piano li assorbe lo stesso, perché prende i saldi della gestione di ogni esercizio.» (the balances of the financial year «Esercizio 2026» do not appear in the Wallet, which shows a single open financial year: the plan absorbs them all the same, because it takes the management's balances of every financial year). An unlinked balance of another financial year, which the plan absorbs but which is not the part, makes the gate say that the program does not know whether it includes the part, instead of asking again for the lines linked to the succession. The instalment figures do not change.

NEW: THE SUCCESSION GATE STOPS IF AN HEIR'S PART, OR THE ONE TAKEN FROM THE DECEASED, WOULD COME IN TWICE — If for an heir, or for the deceased, the plan would absorb their part twice, that is the lines linked to the succession with their part and, next to them, on the same management and the same unit, unlinked balances with the same figure, even in another financial year, the gate stops and says so, with a sentence and a table: for each person the figure and the financial year of the two series, which of the two can be removed from the Wallet (or that neither is in the Wallet), and that the plan absorbs the one that remains at the next generation. In the test, with the two series for all three, the plan would have given Ugo − € 394.52 instead of € 0.00, Anna € 956.71 instead of € 720.00 and Bruno € 637.81 instead of € 480.00. With two deceased persons on the same unit, the same line of an heir does not count as an extra part in the other deceased person's item, even when another heir is still missing theirs. The item can be accepted with the tick and the note, like every item of the gate: it is the way out when a genuine carry-over happens to have the same figure as the part.

CHANGES: THE OPEN SHARE WITH MANY UNITS — The «Quota aperta» (open share) badge shows the sum of the unassigned shares with their sign (an expense of € 75.00 and an income of € 30.00 give € 45.00, not € 105.00) and where they are: the unit by name if there is only one, even on several items; how many units if there are more; the whole items when the share does not belong to a unit (in the test «Quota aperta · € 858,00 (6 unità e 1 voce intera)», open share · € 858.00, 6 units and 1 whole item). With rounding, the sum of the shares can differ by one cent per share from the difference between what the plan asks and what is in the instalments, and the line «Da mettere in rata … − nelle rate … = …» (to be put in instalments … − in the instalments … = …) says so («€ 4,90 le singole quote, la differenza è l'arrotondamento», € 4.90 the single shares, the difference is the rounding). The box at the top of the page groups the shares by cause («Nessun proprietario — 6 unità», no owner — 6 units), with one row per unit and item and the figure, income items with the minus sign; it shows the first five rows of each cause, and «Mostra tutte (9 righe)» (show all, 9 rows) opens the others. Under each item the line of the unassigned amounts names the units (the first two and how many others, if there are more than three) and the cause when it is the same for all («Non assegnati € 540,00 (Cantina 1, Cantina 2 e altre 4: nessun proprietario): restano fuori dalle rate.», unassigned € 540.00, Cellar 1, Cellar 2 and 4 others: no owner, they stay out of the instalments), and also counts the shares of the item's sub-accounts.

NEW: IMMEDIATE SETTLEMENTS RECORDED ON AN INCOME ITEM — Up to 1.11.0-beta.51 the immediate settlement also offered income items, and the registration wrote a cash outflow: the bank or the cash went down by the amount instead of going up. On the «Fatture passive» (supplier invoices) page a box lists the condominium's immediate settlements that have not been reversed, of any financial year, recorded on an item that today is an income item («1 regolazione immediata è registrata su una voce di entrata», 1 immediate settlement is recorded on an income item), with protocol, date, item, amount and «Apri» (open), which leads to the journal entry with the «Storna» (reverse) button: the reversal writes the opposite entry and the bank or the cash goes back to how it was; if the settlement's financial year is closed, the reversal is recorded in an open financial year. Without an open financial year the box says that today the reversal is refused. The box cannot be hidden and disappears when the last settlement is reversed. What counts is the type the item has today: if an item became an income item after a settlement that was a genuine expense, the settlement appears all the same, and before reversing it it is worth checking what it paid for.

FIXES: THE MESSAGES THAT STOP A PLAN ON A MANAGEMENT USED IN MORE THAN ONE FINANCIAL YEAR — On a management linked to more than one financial year, three refusals of the generation state the fact and do not point to paths the page does not offer. (1) A plan created without choosing the items, when all the management's items are already in other active plans and at least one belongs to another financial year, says in which plans and of which financial year, and that on a management used in more than one financial year the program does not yet keep plans of different financial years apart; before, it said «nessuna quota calcolata» (no share calculated) with three checks that had nothing to do with it. (2) The guard on the amount already paid, when the item exceeds its budget only because of the plans of another financial year, names the plans that have the item and says that the amount already paid would be deducted in all of them, without suggesting to raise the item or to deactivate a plan. (3) The same guard, when the item's invoices belong to more than one financial year, or to a financial year other than the plan's, names the financial years with the figure of each and the total, and no longer sends you to update the item's amount. The refusals trigger in the same cases as before and no figure changes.

CHANGES: THE PANEL UPDATE ENGINE — The exchange file that the application writes when you launch the update («Scarica e Installa», download and install) is called update_bridge.json and lives in storage/app; the engine looks for it only there, in the installation folder. The engine starts the update only with that file's token, within the ten minutes of the launch, and after that it says «L'avvio dell'aggiornamento è scaduto: riavvialo dalla dashboard.» (the update launch has expired: start it again from the dashboard); opened on its own, without the launch from the updates page, it starts nothing and points to that page and to the installation file. If the update stops with an error, the engine closes (the exchange file is deleted) and the screen says where to start again: the updates page, which prepares a new one, or the installation file if the application does not answer. On a .env file without TRUSTED_PROXIES, on shared hosting or behind a proxy, the engine writes TRUSTED_PROXIES=PRIVATE_SUBNETS. The launch page says «L'aggiornamento richiede qualche minuto: non chiudere la pagina.» (the update takes a few minutes: do not close the page) instead of the sentence about maintenance mode, which the panel update does not turn on.

CHANGES: THE INSTALL COMMAND ON AN INSTALLATION ALREADY DONE — The kondomanager:installa command, which the production Docker image runs at every start, recognises an installation already done from the lock file or by asking the database whether there is an administrator: if reading the database fails, it stops with an error without writing anything, as when the database does not answer, and tries again at the next start. On a database that already has the tables it clears only the permissions cache: the rest of the cache, including maintenance mode if it is kept there, stays as it is. The guided installation, which resets the database, clears the whole cache as before.

NEW: THE REPOSITORY'S SECURITY POLICY — The repository has its security policy (the SECURITY.md file), in Italian and in English: a vulnerability is reported privately, from the repository's Security tab with «Report a vulnerability», and not in an issue, which is public. It says which versions receive fixes, the time of the first reply and how to write the fix with a temporary private fork. The README, the contributing guide and the issue template point to it; the contributing guide and the README mention the Contributor License Agreement, which is signed only once, at the first pull request.

FIXES: THE MANUAL UPDATE IN THE README — The section is called «Manual update (with the installer file)» and no longer names a pair of versions. The steps say to extract the index.php file before uploading it, and the button is called «Update now» (in Italian, «Aggiorna ora»), as in the installer. The final note says that at the end the uploaded index.php file deletes itself and, if it cannot, a file answering «410 Gone» remains, to be deleted by hand; if the update is interrupted by an error, the file may remain on the server, and must be deleted by hand.

HOW IT WORKS TODAY, WHERE IT MAKES A DIFFERENCE — (1) The new rules of the panel update engine apply to updates that start from this version: the update to this version is still run by the engine of the installed version. Stay on the page until the end; if it stops with an error, update with the installation file, or try again from the updates page when the «Scarica e Installa» (download and install) button is active again, ten minutes after the launch. (2) A plan created without «Genera calcolo scadenze subito» before this update does not yet have a financial year of its own until its first generation: for it the page and «Sposta spesa» use the financial year that contains its creation date. (3) On a management linked to more than one financial year the program does not yet split the amount already paid of an item across financial years: the plan for the later year on an item with an amount already paid stops when, together with the earlier year's plan, what the plans ask on the item exceeds its amount; the generation or recalculation of a plan also stops when the item's invoices, added up across financial years, exceed the item's amount. The message says so. A plan created without choosing the items takes only those that no other active plan of the management already has, of any financial year: next to the earlier year's plan it takes only the new items, without a message. (4) The succession gate compares the two series summed per person: if the part recorded by hand is in a sum together with a genuine carry-over, the second series is not seen. With two co-owners of the same unit who died on the same day with the same heirs, if an heir has a single unlinked line with the figure of their two parts and no linked line, both items say that the balances are already there, and the plan absorbs the line once. Plans already generated with a part that came in twice are not flagged by any page. (5) With two open financial years in the same condominium the Wallet shows one: the gate's sentences say so («un solo esercizio aperto», a single open financial year), without saying which.
